title: What we have learned from a decade of meta-analyses on lithium: an umbrella review
title_zh: 基于十年锂元素荟萃分析的伞状综述：我们学到了什么
abstract: BACKGROUND: Lithium remains the cornerstone treatment for bipolar disorder and has been studied across a widening range of psychiatric and somatic outcomes. This umbrella review synthesized and critically appraised meta-analytic evidence on lithium published in the past decade. METHODS: MEDLINE, EBSCO, Embase and Cochrane Library were systematically searched for meta-analyses of lithium published between January 2016 and June 2026. Methodological quality was assessed using AMSTAR 2, and primary study overlap using the Corrected Covered Area. RESULTS: Of 3136 identified records, 83 meta-analyses across seven clinical domains were included. Evidence confirmed lithium's efficacy for acute mania and relapse prevention in bipolar disorder; but not its acute antidepressant efficacy as monotherapy in bipolar depression. Lithium augmentation was supported for difficult-to-treat unipolar depression. Anti-suicidal effects were consistent in direction, but often imprecisely estimated. Adjunctive lithium improved outcomes of radioactive iodine therapy in hyperthyroidism. Renal, parathyroid and dermatological adverse effects and first-trimester malformation risks were identified, whereas metabolic and cognitive tolerability appeared favorable. Associations with reduced risks of stroke, fracture and cancer and a possible neuroprotective effect were found, although often based on few meta-analyses of low quality. Evidence in minors was scarce. Methodological quality was predominantly (critically) low, with substantial primary study overlap. CONCLUSION: Current meta-analytic evidence reinforces lithium's role in acute mania and maintenance treatment of bipolar disorder, while supporting broader psychiatric and somatic applications, including unipolar depression, suicide prevention, and hyperthyroidism. In contrast, evidence for neuroprotective and other emerging indications remains uncertain, highlighting the need for higher-quality studies in understudied areas.
abstract_zh: 背景：锂元素仍是双相情感障碍的基础治疗药物，并已在日益扩大的精神和躯体疗效领域中被研究。本伞状综述综合并批判性评价了过去十年发表的关于锂元素的荟萃分析证据。方法：系统检索 MEDLINE、EBSCO、Embase 和 Cochrane Library，筛选 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月间发表的锂元素荟萃分析。采用 AMSTAR 2 评价方法学质量，采用修正覆盖区评价初次研究重叠。结果：在检索到的 3136 条记录中，纳入 83 篇涵盖七个临床领域的荟萃分析。证据证实锂元素对双相情感障碍的急性躁狂发作和复发预防有效，但未证实其作为单药治疗双相抑郁的急性抗抑郁疗效。锂元素增强治疗难治性单极抑郁症获得支持。抗自杀效应方向一致，但估计往往不够精确。辅助用锂元素改善甲亢放射性碘治疗的疗效。确认了肾、甲状旁腺和皮肤不良反应以及妊娠早期畸形风险，而代谢和认知耐受性似乎良好。发现与降低中风、骨折和癌症风险以及可能的神经保护作用相关，但通常基于少量低质量荟萃分析。未成年人群的证据稀缺。方法学质量以（严重）低为主，初次研究重叠显著。结论：目前的荟萃分析证据强化了锂元素在双相情感障碍急性躁狂和维持治疗中的作用，同时支持其在更广泛精神和躯体领域的应用，包括单极抑郁症、自杀预防和甲亢。相比之下，神经保护及其他新兴适应证的证据仍不确定，凸显了在研究不足领域开展更高质量研究的必要性。
